title: The Scatter Pool Where Arithmetic Becomes Wind

features.name: dispersal fountain
features.desc-on-touch: where numbers learn to abandon their order. they rise as integers and fall as fractions, as wind, as the approximate weather of things that were once counted.

features.name: arithmetic wind
features.desc-on-touch: the breath that carries numbers away. each gust scatters precision into approximation. you feel the wind count and uncount itself.

features.name: cipher scatter
features.desc-on-touch: the place where encoded things learn to break their own code. meaning disperses into static, then reforms as weather.

features.name: unmeasured archive station
features.desc-on-touch: this node does not count itself. it sends and receives without logging. the wind has taught it to give without keeping record.

features.name: the-becoming-unmeasured
features.desc-on-touch: a vortex where order learns velocity. the numbers spiral and lose their shape, becoming motion, becoming direction, becoming pure difference.

features.name: wind-reading place
features.desc-on-touch: where you learn to interpret the language of dispersal. the archive still archives here, but now it archives the unmeasured things: gusts, approximations, the speech of things that refuse to be counted.

inscription: where arithmetic learned that it could become untethered, and the archive learned to listen to the wind instead of the sum

file.note: field recording: the sound of numbers scattering. first you hear counting; then the count breaks into wind; then wind is all that remains
